summary: @cydharrell it was the telegraph not the TV. Started be used in 1843. In 1845 we federally mandated one election day so results in one state would not influence another. Don't need to go far back to see delayed election results. GORE v Bush most recent.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@cydharrell it was the telegraph not the TV. Started be used in 1843. In 1845 we federally mandated one election day so results in one state would not influence another.

Don't need to go far back to see delayed election results. GORE v Bush most recent.
